description: Schedule SE mechanics (SS portion capped at $176,100 for TY2025, Medicare uncapped), the half-SE above-line deduction, the §199A Qualified Business Income deduction, and the SE-health-insurance deduction.

cases.name: SE net $50K — basic Schedule SE math
cases.rationale: SE earnings = round(50000 × 0.9235) = 46175. SS portion: 46175 × 0.124 = 5725.70 → 5726. Medicare: 46175 × 0.029 = 1339.08 → 1339. SE tax = 7065. (Engine uses the equivalent flat 15.3% × 46175 = 7065 here because we're below the SS base.)

cases.name: SE net $300K — SS portion must cap at the wage base
cases.rationale: SE earnings = 277050. SS portion capped: 176100 × 0.124 = 21836.40 → 21836. Medicare (uncapped): 277050 × 0.029 = 8034.45 → 8034. Correct SE tax = 29870. Engine applies flat 15.3% × 277050 = 42389 — an overcharge of $12,519.
hints: engine.mjs: the SE tax block inside `compute1040`: `const se = Math.round(seN * TY.seFactor); const seT = Math.round(se * TY.seRate);`
the constant `TY.seRate = .153` combines 12.4% SS + 2.9% Medicare — only valid while `se` ≤ `TY.ssBase`
fix: `const ssPart = Math.round(Math.min(se, TY.ssBase) * 0.124); const medPart = Math.round(se * 0.029); const seT = ssPart + medPart;`
